annotations.title: Compile an offer into negotiation rules

description:
Turn a seller's offer, described in plain words, into negotiation RULES an AI agent cannot break.

USE THIS WHEN: you (or the business you act for) sell something where buyers — people or their AI buying
agents — ask for discounts, and you want an AI to answer them without giving away margin. Describe the offer:
the listed price, the lowest price you'd take for a plain deal, what you'd trade a discount for (financing with
you, a trade-in, a longer commitment, paying sooner, buying this week…), extras you can add and what they cost
you, and anything never on the table. Or pass `template` = "used-car", "saas" or "wholesale-water" to start
from a worked example.

Compiling a description runs a language model and needs an `access_key` (pilot businesses get one at
https://snhp.dev/#pilot); templates are free.

Returns {ok, policy, issues, summary}: `policy` is the machine-readable rule set (pass it to
draft_negotiation_reply), `summary` restates the floor, walk-away, what can be traded and the limits in plain
words, and `issues` lists what to fix before going live (e.g. a floor below cost).
